name: Brew & Desk
tagline: A coffee shop built for working

listing.description: A site for a café-coworking, anti-café or business lounge. A bento grid with a live clock, day and month plans, and meeting rooms priced by the hour.

seo.title: Brew & Desk — café-coworking in Tashkent City
seo.description: Coffee, lunches and workspace at 5 Furqat St: fast Wi-Fi, sockets at every table, meeting rooms for 4 and 8 by the hour and a day pass with unlimited filter coffee.
seo.answer: Brew & Desk is a café-coworking at 5 Furqat St in Tashkent City, open daily from 8 am to 11 pm. A cappuccino costs 28,000 UZS, a day pass with unlimited filter coffee 110,000 UZS and a four-person meeting room 90,000 UZS an hour.

sections.title: Coffee on the desk, deadline under control
sections.subtitle: Specialty coffee, lunches and desks with a socket at every table. Meeting rooms by the hour, a call-free quiet zone and 500 Mbit/s Wi-Fi.

items.title: Main hall
items.text: Long tables by the windows, a socket and lamp at every seat. Talking allowed.

items.title: Quiet zone
items.text: No calls or chatter, soft armchairs, shelves of books.

items.title: Meeting room “Mini”
items.text: A table for four, a screen and a whiteboard.

items.title: Meeting room “Maxi”
items.text: For presentations and calls: camera, sound, coffee break on request.

items.title: Phone booths
items.text: Two soundproof booths for calls, free for up to 30 minutes.

items.title: Terrace
items.text: In summer, outdoor tables overlooking the boulevard.

sections.label: About
sections.title: A café first, an office second
sections.text: Brew & Desk is not a coworking space with a coffee machine but a real café with specialty beans and a kitchen, where everything is designed for work: light, sockets, quiet and chairs you can sit on for eight hours. Bring your laptop or hold meetings in the rooms.

items.q: Can I stay all day with one coffee?
items.a: In the main hall, yes. The quiet zone and unlimited filter come with the 110,000 UZS day pass.

items.q: How do I book a meeting room?
items.a: Leave a request with the date and time and we confirm within 15 minutes.
Yes, black-and-white and colour printing at the bar; the first 10 pages are free.

items.q: Do you issue documents for companies?
items.a: Yes, for the monthly plan and meeting rooms we issue a contract and invoice.

sections.label: Contact
sections.title: Save a desk for tomorrow
sections.text: 5 Furqat St, Tashkent City, ground floor. Every day 8 am to 11 pm. Book desks and meeting rooms through the form.
